portfolio.intro: My personal website, built with Nuxt and TypeScript. You are on it right now! This version is the result of a rebuild in April 2026. It does not do all that much; I mainly needed somewhere to put my little essays.
portfolio.hydcraft: A website I made for my own Minecraft server, with account linking, player profiles, server information, and that sort of thing. You can find more in the Hydroline organization on GitHub, along with a few other projects.
portfolio.teps: A practice site I made for myself and my classmates during our 2024 transition exam from secondary to higher vocational education. It served one final class in 2025 before retiring. I keep it online as a memento.
